report.title: Hard negatives and failure analysis (CLIP ViT-B/32, Flickr30k test T→I)
report.description: 2058 of 5000 queries miss at rank 1; 59.8% of those have the target in the top 5 (near misses). For 499 failures (24.2%) the wrongly top-ranked image has a human caption at least as similar to the query as the target's own other captions — i.e. the 'hard negative' is plausibly also a correct answer that Flickr30k's one-image-per-caption labels count as wrong. Category R@1 uses keyword heuristics; categories overlap.
